title: Polynomial augmentation has cotangent complex equal to the conormal module
statement: Let $n\geq0$, let $P=\mathbf Z[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, let $B=\mathbf Z$ with the augmentation $x_i\mapsto0$, and let $J=(x_1,\ldots,x_n)$. For the standard cotangent complex of [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], there is a canonical isomorphism $L_{B/P}\simeq(J/J^2)[1]$ in $D(B)$. The classes of the $x_i$ form a $B$-basis of $J/J^2$, and the assertion includes the case $n=0$, where both sides are zero.
